notes.title: Shadows of Souls is Now Free to Play
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Shadows of Souls is now completely free to play!

In this side-scrolling beat’em up runner, you’ll take control of a lone fighter navigating through relentless waves of enemies. The game blends fast-paced combat with endless runner mechanics — where quick reactions and smart upgrades are the keys to survival.

Each run earns you currency to strengthen your character, unlock new abilities, and push further than before. Whether you're aiming to beat your high score or finally conquer that brutal level, every attempt brings you closer.

 *  Fluid left-right movement with responsive combo-based combat

 *  Progressive difficulty and increasingly intense waves

 *  Permanent upgrades to help you go further with each run

 *  Stylized visuals and atmospheric soundtrack

Now’s the perfect time to dive in and start fighting your way through the shadows.
Download Shadows of Souls today — and see how far you can go.
